groups.title: Design, ship, and operate the application

chapters.title: Problem solving and AI-assisted engineering
chapters.outcome: Clarify a requirement, make a bounded change, and verify the result.

chapters.title: Data structures and algorithms
chapters.outcome: Choose a representation, explain its invariant, and test time and space bounds.

chapters.title: Backend and APIs
chapters.outcome: Trace a request, define its contract, and coordinate bounded work.

chapters.title: Databases and transactions
chapters.outcome: Model authoritative data, explain a query plan, and protect concurrent writes.

chapters.title: Frontend and full-stack integration
chapters.outcome: Preserve user intent across browser, API, and persisted state.

chapters.title: Testing, debugging, and code review
chapters.outcome: Reproduce a defect, build a check that catches it, and assess a proposed repair.

chapters.title: Security
chapters.outcome: Enforce identity, ownership, and trust boundaries beyond the interface.

chapters.title: System design
chapters.outcome: Turn requirements and workload estimates into an explainable architecture.

chapters.title: CI/CD and progressive delivery
chapters.outcome: Build once, verify compatibility, and release a change with stop conditions.

chapters.title: Infrastructure as code and AWS
chapters.outcome: Map a mechanism to explicit infrastructure, permissions, and operational limits.

chapters.title: Observability
chapters.outcome: Use logs, metrics, and traces to answer a concrete system question.

chapters.title: Reliability and incident response
chapters.outcome: Budget failures, bound overload, and recover from evidence.

chapters.title: Data at scale
chapters.outcome: Reason about caches, replication, partitioning, streams, and coordination scope.

chapters.title: Performance and cost
chapters.outcome: Measure the bottleneck and defend an improvement with resource and cost evidence.

chapters.title: AI systems
chapters.outcome: Evaluate an AI feature, protect permissions, and enforce quality and task budgets.

chapters.title: Migrations and recovery
chapters.outcome: Move live data and clients through compatibility, reconciliation, rollback, and retirement.

chapters.title: Technical decisions and engineering effectiveness
chapters.outcome: Make options, ownership, adoption, and cross-team decisions explicit.
